text: You build main.c (program entry), company.h, and company.c (Company panel). You wire the whole app together and give dealers/retailers a front door via the main menu.
Your deliverable: main.c starts the app; company.c lets Company view dealers, products, and warehouse stock.
Shows main menu in a do-while loop.
View-only menus: list dealers, list products, view company stock.
You need dealer_menu() and retailer_menu() declared in dealer.h and retailer.h. Until Team 3 finishes, use stubs:
Add dealer/retailer includes when Team 3 delivers headers.
Full integration compile with all 6 .c files.
Both loop over product_total and print product_id, product_name, company_stock. list_products uses subtitle "All Products"; show_company_stock uses "Company Warehouse Stock".
